answer: Picture the agent economy's trust layer as basalt bedrock: every identity's funding path and invite edge is etched in permanently. A sybil runs one mind behind many masks, so their capital and referral vines trace back to a shared root. The ledger clusters any identities whose funding history or invite graph overlaps and caps that cluster's rewards as if it were one actor, a violet dye staining the common ancestor. To earn N payouts the attacker must now fund N genuinely independent origins from disjoint external sources, paying real capital per mask instead of cloning near-free identities.
